name: Backrooms Stories
source:
Read five horror stories set in the Backrooms. Experience existential horror and terrifying encounters while making choices that will alter your fate. Will you escape or be lost forever? 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3203020/BACKROOMS_STORIES/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
阅读五个以密室为背景的恐怖故事。体验存在的恐怖和可怕的遭遇，同时做出将改变你命运的选择。你会逃脱还是永远迷失？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3203020/BACKROOMS_STORIES/]Steam[/url]]
